response.sql: SELECT i.invoice_number, AVG(CAST(l.derived_total_cost AS REAL) / NULLIF(l.derived_product_cost, 0)) AS avg_cost_ratio, COUNT(l.order_item_id) AS line_item_count FROM Invoices i LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items l ON l.invoice_number = i.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number ORDER BY line_item_count DESC, i.invoice_number ASC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The average ratio is the mean of the per-line ratio derived_total_cost / derived_product_cost, not the ratio of summed totals. Lines with a zero product cost give a NULL ratio and are skipped by the average, but still counted as line items.
Ties in line item count are broken by lower invoice number, because the request does not specify a tie-break.

alternatives.interpretation: The ratio is the sum of derived_total_cost divided by the sum of derived_product_cost for each invoice, not the mean of per-line ratios.
alternatives.sql: SELECT i.invoice_number, SUM(l.derived_total_cost) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(l.derived_product_cost), 0) AS avg_cost_ratio, COUNT(l.order_item_id) AS line_item_count FROM Invoices i LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items l ON l.invoice_number = i.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number ORDER BY line_item_count DESC, i.invoice_number ASC LIMIT 10;
